patches.reason: Require the exact server-tracked Workspace car for the requesting player before honoring client-triggered car lock, driver-lock, or removal events.

Prevent the archived touch ControlScript from waiting forever for an optional legacy click-to-move fail-state BindableEvent before it creates the thumbstick and jump controls on modern Roblox mobile clients.

Do not block every player's house forever when one or more archived furniture assets cannot be preloaded in modern Roblox. Allow the base house to load after a short bounded wait while the legacy preload continues in the background.

replacements.old:
if objectsready == false then
			repeat wait(math.random()) until objectsready == true
		end
replacements.new:
if objectsready == false then
			local preloadWaitStarted = tick()
			repeat wait(.25) until objectsready == true or tick() - preloadWaitStarted >= 6
		end
